race.comment: GOLDEN TUNES (5) has made a strong case with successive wins at this venue, latest taking out a BM64 by six lengths after being sent out as odds-on favourite. His record at this track is faultless from three attempts and the latest win reads well enough to make him the horse to beat. LIMITED RISK (6) returns from a two-month freshen after winning a BM64 over 1400m at this track and has trialled with a close third at Strathalbyn, so there is enough to suggest he can run well again back to 1100m. HELLIVIT (10) resumed with a three-length BM58 win and has a strong track-and-distance record, helped by a weight drop from that latest victory. Include. DYER (4) won narrowly by a neck last time out at this track but is up in weight. Expected to go close.
